answer: The system uses insurance staking to resist Sybils: each identity locks 40 units for 60 days, and the lock is forfeited when a jury finds copied work, so each fake needs its own separate 40 units at risk. To release the lock, the operator carries a 10-kilogram timber beam 100 meters until its end is level with the horizon, then holds a velvet pad against a sensor for 30 seconds without interruption. A missed carry, a level miss, or contact under 30 seconds restarts the 60 days, so 100 fakes need 4,000 locked units and 100 separate carries.
